title: tc-cited-answer
description: An AI answer with numbered source markers, source chips and an in-place source preview.

segments.description: The answer as text segments, each naming the sources it relies on – a numbered marker ends each cited one

sources.description: The sources, numbered in this order – chips under the answer and the passages their previews quote

pagesRead.description: Pages the model read while searching – shown in the head next to the source count

preview.description: Id of the source whose preview is open (null: closed)

openHandled.description: The app opens sources itself (it listens to tc-open-source): links don't navigate, and sources without a url get Open source too

actionLabel.description: A button on the tray that fires tc-action, e.g. "Follow up"

text.description: A sentence or part of one. Spaces at the start or end are kept outside the highlight

cite.description: Ids of the sources this text relies on – one marker each, in this order

title.description: Headline of the page or document

site.description: Short name on the chip, e.g. "Latency Notes"

quote.description: The passage the answer relies on

highlight.description: Words or phrases of the quote to mark. Without it, words the quote shares with the citing sentences are marked
